cohort: The study included a patient group of 40 newborns and their mothers who developed pathological jaundice despite the absence of known risk factors, and a control group of 36 infants and their mothers who did not develop pathological jaundice.
finding: Newborn plasma vitamin B12 and folate levels were significantly lower in the group with pathological jaundice, and lower neonatal folate and vitamin B12 levels, along with higher maternal 25(OH) vitamin D levels, were associated with pathological jaundice.
cross-section timing: At the time of developing pathological jaundice in newborns
